fact.subject: Lambda
fact.object: NVIDIA Photonics 共封装光学交换机

evidence.quote: Lambda is tackling the network piece of the puzzle with NVIDIA Photonics co-packaged optics (CPO) switches.
In the company’s tests using the switches, network latency — the time needed for moving data — dropped by about 4% at rack scale and by up to about 10% at pod scale.

title: Lambda Boosts AI Factory Resiliency and Efficiency With NVIDIA Photonics
displayTitle: Lambda 在万卡集群部署英伟达共封装光学交换机
summary: 英伟达称 Lambda 使用共封装光学交换机连接超过一万颗 GPU 的 GB300 NVL72 机架，测试中机架级延迟下降约 4%、pod 级最多下降约 10%。
investorNote: CPO 的商业价值要用集群停机率、全链路功耗和维护成本检验。
narrative: 英伟达称 Lambda 使用共封装光学交换机连接超过一万颗 GPU 的 GB300 NVL72 机架，测试中机架级延迟下降约 4%、pod 级最多下降约 10%。 CPO 的商业价值要用集群停机率、全链路功耗和维护成本检验。
